name: helix
description: Helix — a durable, policy-controlled autonomous multi-agent orchestration runtime.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node benchmarks/runtime.mjs
scripts.golden-demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node examples/golden-demo.mjs
scripts.sandbox-demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-sandbox-demo.js
scripts.memory-benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/memory-learning.js
